gone.title: This deploy is no longer listed
gone.body: Finished deploys stay here for a short while. Open the stack to see what is running now.

error.title: Couldn't load the deploy.
error.body: Check the connection and try again.

failed.title: Deploy failed
failed.stopped_one: Bayplan stopped at {{step}}. {{done}} of {{count}} service was updated before it stopped, and nothing was rolled back.
failed.stopped_other: Bayplan stopped at {{step}}. {{done}} of {{count}} services were updated before it stopped, and nothing was rolled back.

cancelled.title: Deploy cancelled
cancelled.body: Bayplan stopped at the step it had reached.
cancelled.stopped_one: Bayplan stopped at {{step}}. {{done}} of {{count}} service was already updated.
cancelled.stopped_other: Bayplan stopped at {{step}}. {{done}} of {{count}} services were already updated.

cancel.title: Cancel this deploy?
cancel.body: Bayplan stops at the step it has reached. Services already updated stay updated, and objects created for this deploy that nothing uses are removed.
cancel.failed: Couldn't cancel the deploy. Try again.

cleanup.removed_one: The {{count}} object created for this deploy that nothing uses was removed.
cleanup.removed_other: The {{count}} objects created for this deploy that nothing uses were removed.
cleanup.removedCancelled: Objects created for this deploy that nothing uses were removed.
cleanup.left: Bayplan couldn't remove {{list}}. Remove them under Networks, Secrets or Configs.
cleanup.label: Cleaned up

rollback.title: Rolling back {{name}}
rollback.noPrevious: There's no earlier deployed version to roll back to.

errors.needsAdmin: The version to roll back to uses host access, which needs Admin. Ask an administrator to roll it back.
errors.noPrevious: There's no earlier deployed version to roll back to.
errors.invalid: That version can't be deployed again as it is. Open the editor to fix it, then deploy.
errors.tooMany: You already have 5 jobs running. Wait for one to finish.
errors.target: This environment is no longer the kind of target this stack was created for.
errors.clash: Something Bayplan does not manage already uses this stack's name on this environment.
errors.lost: Bayplan couldn't tell whether the roll back started. Open the stack to see where it stands.
errors.generic: Couldn't start the roll back. Try again.

lastFailed.title: The last deploy failed
lastFailed.titleRollbackCancelled: The last roll back was cancelled
lastFailed.stoppedAtCancelled: Bayplan stopped at {{service}}. Nothing was rolled back.
lastFailed.stoppedCancelled: Bayplan stopped at the step it had reached. Nothing was rolled back.
lastFailed.interrupted: The deploy was interrupted when Bayplan stopped. The swarm may be partly updated.
lastFailed.interruptedRollback: The roll back was interrupted when Bayplan stopped. The swarm may be partly updated.

reason.converge_timeout: It didn't settle in time. Docker may still finish it.
reason.tasks_failed: Its tasks stopped and the swarm won't start them again.
reason.network_full: A network of the stack has no free addresses.
reason.update_stopped: The swarm stopped the update of the service.
reason.service_changed: Someone else changed the service while the deploy ran.
reason.service_name_taken: The swarm already has a service of that name.
reason.needs_admin: The stack uses host access that needs Admin.
reason.policy_unavailable: The host-access policy could not be applied.
reason.image_unresolved: An image could not be looked up.
reason.registry_unreachable: A registry could not be reached.
reason.registry_unresolved: The registry credential for an image could not be read.
reason.no_manager_connected: No manager of the swarm is connected to Bayplan.
reason.host_read_only: The host is read-only, so Bayplan can't change it.
reason.network_conflict: The swarm already has a network of that name that this stack does not own.
reason.network_failed: The swarm could not create a network.
reason.object_failed: The swarm could not create a secret or config.
reason.object_invalid: A secret or config of the stack has no usable content.
reason.object_name_taken: The swarm already has a secret or config of that name that this stack does not own.
reason.external_missing: A network, secret or config the stack names as external does not exist.
reason.stack_name_clash: A stack of that name already exists here that Bayplan does not manage.
reason.engine_error: The engine could not complete the request.
